title: Retractions Revisited: A Replication, Extension, and Mechanistic Evaluation of Linguistic Obfuscation Effects in Fraudulent Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.13678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prior work suggests fraudulent scientists write their articles with higher rates of linguistic obfuscation than genuine scientists, with a possible mechanism suggesting obfuscation makes research more costly for a reader to analyze. This result has not undergone additional empirical scrutiny in the open science era, nor have other psychological mechanisms been evaluated. The current replication and extension addressed this opportunity by comparing 800 fraudulent and 800 genuine control papers (2013-2025). The results supported the linguistic obfuscation hypothesis, suggesting fraudulent papers were more obfuscated than genuine ones. A parallel mediation model evaluated three competing mechanisms, finding that reality monitoring, as measured through decreased rates of adjectives, best explained the link between fraudulent science and linguistic obfuscation. translated_title: 撤稿研究再审视：欺诈科学中语言模糊化效应的复制、扩展与机制评估
translated_abstract: 先前的研究表明，欺诈性科学家撰写的文章比真正的科学家使用更高比率的语言模糊化表达，一种可能的机制认为模糊化会增加读者分析研究的成本。这一结果尚未在开放科学时代接受进一步的实证检验，其他心理机制也未曾被评估。本研究通过复制与扩展工作弥补了这一空白，比较了800篇欺诈性论文和800篇真实的对照论文（2013-2025年）。结果支持了语言模糊化假设，表明欺诈性论文比真实论文更加模糊。一个并行中介模型评估了三种相互竞争的机制，发现通过形容词使用率降低所衡量的“现实监测”机制最能解释欺诈科学与语言模糊化之间的联系。基于模糊化特征的交叉验证检测准确率为60.7%，并采用弹性（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过比较800篇欺诈性与800篇真实性科学论文，复制并证实了欺诈论文具有更高语言模糊化的结论，并通过并行中介模型发现“现实监测”机制（体现为形容词使用减少）是解释这一现象的最佳心理机制。
en_tdlr: By comparing 800 fraudulent and 800 genuine scientific papers, this study replicated and confirmed that fraudulent papers exhibit higher linguistic obfuscation, with a parallel mediation model revealing that reality monitoring (measured by decreased adjective use) best explains this link.
